notes.title: "Miss Peacock" Version 1.0 Release & Final Closed Beta Preparation
notes.notes:
[p]Dear Players,[/p][p align="start"]The closed beta has now reached [b]v1.0[/b], meaning the official launch is just around the corner.[/p][p align="start"]Currently, we are polishing the game and preparing for the [b]final closed beta test[/b].[/p][p align="start"]Stay tuned for more updates![/p][p align="start"][b]\[Otter Club Games][/b]
[b]\[September 8, 2025][/b][/p]

notes.title: Miss Peacock Build v0.12.0 Update Coming Soon
notes.notes:
[p][b]Dear Players,[/b][/p][p]Thank you for your support and patience with [i]"Miss Peacock"[/i]![/p][p]The game is still in the polishing phase. The latest internal version has reached [b]v0.12.0[/b], with further optimizations to the [b]UI[/b], fixes for various [b]bugs[/b] reported during the first beta test, and significant improvements to the overall gameplay experience.[/p][p]Due to the substantial volume of updates, we are currently evaluating whether to conduct a [b]second beta test[/b]. If confirmed, we will announce the details in our official community groups and invite both new and returning players to participate.[/p][p]We deeply appreciate your companionship on this journey.[/p][p][b]\[Otter Club Games][/b]
[b]\[June 17, 2025][/b][/p]

notes.title: Miss Peacock：Build v0.9.0 Update Launched
Miss Peacock Beta version test is coming!
notes.notes:
Those who are interested in participating in the internal testing of game [b]Miss Peacock Beta version[/b] please fill out the test registration form. 
The name of the people who complete the entire process of the Beta version test will appear on the credit list.
